verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented API versioning scheme and no deprecation policy. The only hint is a Postman collection URL slug containing 'flutterwave-v3'. That implies a versioned API exists, but it is not documentation of versioning guarantees. Nothing addresses deprecation timelines, sunset notices or migration commitments, which are the core of the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
